negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No public GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS application or registered foreign exception was located for BiLira or TRYB as of 2026-10-07 in the checked sources. The current issuer terms identify the Turkish legal entity and temporary Turkish crypto-asset-service-provider listing, while expressly disclaiming EMI, credit-institution and licensed-entity status. The OCC charter table is limited to pending bank applications. The SCRC procedural rule does not approve any named issuer or state regime.

genius.notes: The existing legal issuer string is preserved. Turkish CASP-list inclusion is not GENIUS qualification. TRYB references Turkish lira; the Act defines monetary value using national currencies, so a non-USD peg does not establish exclusion. Issuer terms publish reserve and 1:1 redemption arrangements, subject to fees and verification. The current audit index links February, May and August 2026 reports, establishing a quarterly rather than monthly published cadence. The linked August PDF was opened but its image-only body was not recovered; no new attestation contents are asserted. The expected issuer/foreign-lawful-order effective date remains January 18, 2027 and the general DASP licensing restriction July 18, 2028 in the opened Treasury proposal. No foreign exception registration or specific compliance pathway was located.
